capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→纳特→现在就去，在火山口连续点击3次触发战斗；打败获得纳特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 强化消不掉、弱化无效，用水系、圣灵系精灵车轮战（布鲁卡卡、鲁斯王、迈尔斯、斯加尔卡、斯普林特）。

engine_notes: stages_unclearable: the player cannot clear its stat boosts (4399 2012-10-12: 天生攻击等级+2，无法消强化; the guide calls 不能被消强化 a trait seldom seen before).
status_on_attacker: after the player's pet attacks it, the attacker is burned for 2-3 turns (必出现2-3回合烧伤).
速度奇慢（比速度184的鲁斯王还慢）: spe x0.4 estimate so every player pet moves first.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
skills: species 1377's last four at or below Lv80. 4399 battle screenshots (2012-10-12) and 2012 fight videos show 爆裂岩浆拳, 火之神力 and 巨石飞掷; 岩浆喷射 is not seen.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 guide 2012-10-12: 体力8000, 天生攻击+2无法消强化, 不吃弱化与异常, 攻击后烧伤2-3回合.
